races.title: State Senate, District 30
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Bob J. Archuleta
cands.bio: Democratic state senator for District 30. U.S. Army paratrooper (82nd Airborne) and former Montebello reserve police officer. Served multiple terms on the Pico Rivera City Council, including as mayor. Elected to the state Senate in 2018 and chairs the Senate Military and Veterans Affairs Committee.

controversies.text: In March 2021, a former district director sued Sen. Archuleta, the state Senate and others in Los Angeles court. She alleged unwanted comments and advances in 2019, and retaliation after she refused them. He called the allegations "completely and categorically false." No court finding has been reported.

endorsements.text: 2026 endorsements listed by Ballotpedia include the Democratic Party of California, the California Federation of Labor Unions (AFL-CIO), the California Teachers Association, the National Union of Healthcare Workers and Equality California.

cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions by Archuleta on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor purchases of land, growth and land protection, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay, gun laws, abortion or school choice. His campaign site speaks only in general terms about public safety, education and the environment. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys for 2022, 2024 or 2026. We found no dates for his Pico Rivera City Council service or his term as mayor. We could not find where he lived or worked as an adult beyond his Pico Rivera residence and local service. No data-center or development statements were found.

local.label: Roots 100: Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Los Angeles and says he grew up in Lincoln Heights, Los Angeles; he now lives in Pico Rivera.

cands.name: Araceli Martinez
cands.bio: Republican candidate for California State Senate District 30 in 2026. Describes herself as a small business owner and daughter of immigrants, with a UC Riverside degree and years of work as a journalist and political analyst. No elected office held.

endorsements.text: Republican Party of California (listed by Ballotpedia)

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was born or raised, when she came to California, or the name and details of her business. We found no record of elected office or legislative work. We found no documented stance on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, abortion, guns, school choice or H-1B and immigration enforcement. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. The 'Read Araceli's Full Story' page on her campaign site was not available to us. We found no controversies, foreign ties or documented actions in office.
